subject.size_in_frame: about 0.48 of frame height, held at a constant screen position while the hall travels behind her

headroom: about 0.20 of frame height, constant through the move; the mosaic dado runs past high above her and never gets closer.
horizon_eyeline: Lens keeping pace at 0.20 m across the flag joints: the joints stream through the bottom of frame as the only motion cue. Her eyeline is level at 0.52 and moves with the argument — out to frame right on the first outcome, back to her own hand on the second.

layers.fg: flagstone joints streaming through the near frame, and her counting fingers held up at chest height
layers.mg: Alice walking out across the flagstones, thinking aloud
layers.bg: the glass legs passing through frame behind her like columns, and the mosaic dado running past high above

gaze.note: she walks and looks screen right, the direction she is travelling, with about 0.40 of frame width of open floor ahead of her — the largest lead room in S07, because the reasoning needs somewhere to go. Both lines land whole inside this shot with clear silence at each end.

balance: Figure in the left third, empty travelled floor filling the right — a classic walking frame, deliberately conventional, so that all the interest sits in what she is saying.
leading_lines: The flag joints and the dado band both rake in the direction of travel; the glass legs pass through as a slow vertical beat that measures the distance covered.
eye_first: Her face, then her counting fingers.
constraint_binding: The reasoning MOVES — it is given a body and a direction, never a static talking head: the composition is a travelling two-thirds profile with constant subject placement, so the thinking has a heading. Both lines land whole inside this shot with clear silence at each end, so the frame does not change size or axis at any point during the speech.
